Subject: Cross-region RTO/RPO — request for documented acknowledgement

Hi Jonas / Ben,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier today. As we discussed, ZephyrPay will be running primary inference workloads out of eu-west-1 with a standby failover in eu-central-1. Your team mentioned that during a full-region outage there is an operational RTO of ~2 hours and an effective RPO of ~15 minutes for session state (prefix KV) given the current caching strategy and async replication constraints.

From a compliance and procurement standpoint we need Redwood to confirm this behavior in writing and provide a short plan and timeline for the following items: 
- A formal acknowledgement that the multi-region failover path carries those RTO/RPO characteristics
- Any mitigating controls (circuit-breakers, progressive traffic ramp, cache warming) you intend to enact at failover
- A signed acknowledgement (PDF or DocuSign) from Redwood leadership accepting the residual risk or proposing alternative SLA terms

We are on a procurement timeline and would like the acknowledgment before our legal team finalizes the PO (target 2026-12-20). Attaching our internal runbook excerpt for context.

Can you confirm?

Alex
Alex Geller
Head of Infrastructure, ZephyrPay

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 09:12 AM Alex Geller <alex.geller@zephyrpay.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the walkthrough earlier today...

Alex — thanks for the note and for sharing the runbook excerpt. Confirming receipt and we can produce the acknowledgement you asked for. To be explicit up-front: the platform's recommended failover profile for the eu pair is currently an operational RTO target of 2 hours and RPO (session prefix state) of ~15 minutes given our current cross-region replication and KV warming behavior. Those numbers are what our Dedicated instance will operate under without additional customization.

What I will do next: 
- Share a short Redwood acknowledgement document that restates the RTO/RPO and lists mitigation steps (cache pre-warm, progressive traffic ramp, sticky-session drain windows). See attached: dr-runbook-v3.pdf and rto-rpo-metrics.csv.
- Request internal sign-off from Sarah (legal) and Laura for the formal acknowledgement; I have cc'd Laura and Marissa to get commercial acceptance and to coordinate the DocuSign route.

If ZephyrPay needs a tighter RTO/RPO guarantee (e.g., RTO < 1 hour), we can evaluate options: dedicated cross-region replication (engineering effort), stronger pre-warm SLAs, or a small pre-provisioned warm pool — but that will change pricing and lead time. Happy to outline options after we lock the immediate acknowledgement.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: dr-runbook-v3.pdf (pdf), rto-rpo-metrics.csv (csv)
